candidates.title: Track uncataloged inventory
candidates.statement: The system shall allow uncataloged material to be tracked as inventory even when individual bibliographic records are not available.
candidates.source_quote: we need to be able to track these as inventory even though they're not fully cataloged

candidates.title: Bulk processing for uncataloged shipments
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a bulk distribution/processing mode that enables quick distribution of uncataloged shipments with minimal per-item branch labor.
candidates.source_quote: quick distribution (we need to process these fast), minimal branch labor

candidates.title: Usage tracking for uncataloged items
candidates.statement: The system shall record and report how uncataloged material is being used (usage metrics) so staff can evaluate circulation and use.
candidates.source_quote: ability to identify how the material is being used

candidates.title: Include uncataloged transactions in stats
candidates.statement: The system shall count transactions for uncataloged items and include those transactions in circulation statistics and reports.
candidates.source_quote: We also need to count transactions and include them in circulation statistics and reports

candidates.title: Item transfer utility
candidates.statement: The system shall provide an item transfer utility to move batches of items between branches and special locations (e.g., mobile units, outreach collections).
candidates.source_quote: The item transfer utility is crucial for us

candidates.title: Query by inactivity and location
candidates.statement: The system shall allow queries for candidate materials using criteria such as location (e.g., children's section) and circulation inactivity (e.g., not circulated in 6 months).
candidates.source_quote: Maybe we want all items in the children's section that haven't circulated in 6 months

candidates.title: Save reusable queries
candidates.statement: The system shall allow users to save queries for repeated use (for example, monthly reuse of a saved query).
candidates.source_quote: save these queries for repeated use - we do this monthly

candidates.title: Manual selection from query results
candidates.statement: The system shall allow manual selection of titles/items from query results to permit targeted transfers or actions.
candidates.source_quote: manually select titles from query results if we want to be more targeted

candidates.title: Batch move items to new location
candidates.statement: The system shall support batch modification of selected item records to change their location (move them to a new location).
candidates.source_quote: change records of selected items to move them to a new location

candidates.title: Timed revert of moved items
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a mechanism to revert items back to their original location automatically or by schedule after a configurable period (e.g., when a mobile library returns).
candidates.source_quote: mechanisms for reverting items back to their original location after a set period of time

candidates.title: Missing and damaged report by branch
candidates.statement: The system shall generate a report showing all missing and damaged items per branch to support collection health monitoring.
candidates.source_quote: I need a report that shows all missing and damaged items per branch

candidates.title: In-transit items report with configurable threshold
candidates.statement: The system shall provide an in-transit items report that shows items in transit longer than a configurable number of days, with filters per branch and per system.
candidates.source_quote: The report should show items that have been in-transit for more than X days (configurable), per branch and per system
candidates.priority_signals: used to find items lost during transfers

candidates.title: Merge transit-to and transit-from in report
candidates.statement: The system shall merge transit-to and transit-from records into a single in-transit report for ease of use.
candidates.source_quote: It should merge the transit-to and transit-from into one report

candidates.title: Customizable weeding criteria
candidates.statement: The system shall provide weeding reports that identify items for purging based on customizable criteria (for example, status 'missing' for more than X months or status 'discard/weed').
candidates.source_quote: identify items for purging based on customizable criteria. For example: Item has been in status "missing" for more than X months
candidates.priority_signals: Thomas: "Weeding reports are my most-used report type."

candidates.title: Batch status conversion
candidates.statement: The system shall allow batch conversion of item statuses so staff can change many items at once (for example, change 100 items from 'missing' to 'discard/weed').
candidates.source_quote: change 100 items from "missing" to "discard/weed" in batch

candidates.title: Last copy report
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a last copy report that identifies a library system's last copies to assist catalogers in preservation and catalog editing decisions.
candidates.source_quote: The last copy report is CRITICAL. This singles out a library system's last copies
candidates.priority_signals: marked as CRITICAL by stakeholder; described as critical in interviewer's notes

candidates.title: Last copy support for WorldCat editing
candidates.statement: The system shall present last-copy information in a way that assists catalogers who need to edit WorldCat entries (e.g., provide identifiers or actionable location details).
candidates.source_quote: to assist catalogers who need to edit WorldCat entries

candidates.title: Delete volume entries with copies
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a quick and effective method to delete volume entries together with their associated copy entries.
candidates.source_quote: quick, effective method for deleting volume entries along with copy entries

candidates.title: Delete orphaned bibliographic records
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a quick and effective method to identify and delete bibliographic records that have no item records attached (orphaned records).
candidates.source_quote: records with no items attached. Right now, cleaning up these orphaned records takes forever

candidates.title: Track deletions for audit
candidates.statement: The system shall count and track record deletions per location and per system and record the reason for each deletion to support auditing and reporting to directors.
candidates.source_quote: count and track record deletions per location and per system. ... directors want to know how many records we've deleted and why
candidates.priority_signals: requested for auditing and director reporting

candidates.title: Shelf space report comparing percentages
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a shelf space report that, for each genre and format, compares percentage of total circulations, percentage of the collection, and percentage of total shelf space.
candidates.source_quote: For each genre and format, I need to compare: - Percentage of total circulations - Percentage of the collection - Percentage of total shelf space

candidates.title: Material volume report with breakdowns
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a material volume report showing volumes based on acquisitions, items on shelf, and items in circulation, with breakdowns by categories such as total items, holds, adult fiction, and board books.
candidates.source_quote: report on volume based on acquisitions, items on shelf, and items in circulation, broken down by categories like total items, holds, adult fiction, board books

candidates.title: Data quality reports
candidates.statement: The system shall provide data quality reports that identify items with invalid item types, items with excessively long call numbers, and bibliographic records that have no item records.
candidates.source_quote: Data quality reports - items with invalid item type, items with long call numbers, bibliographic records with no item records
candidates.priority_signals: interviewer notes emphasized data quality importance

candidates.title: Last edit date excluding circulation
candidates.statement: The system shall display the last edit date on items in reports reflecting the last bibliographic or item record edit, and shall exclude circulation events from updating that last edit date.
candidates.source_quote: see the last edit date on reports, but it should be only when the item is edited and not include the last circulation
